title: “Rivet” cations enhance mechanical stability of Ni-rich layered cathode materials for Li-ion batteries
abstract: Published online: 11 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43246-026-01425-1 Mg²⁺ and Ni²⁺ ions at Li sites enhance Ni-rich NMC stability by acting as structural rivets that suppress layer gliding and cracking. Here, the authors show that Mg²⁺ and Ni²⁺ at Li sites synergistically enhance the mechanical strength and toughness of single-crystal NMC811.

title: Magneto-Electrocatalysis of Co–Ni Alloy Electrodeposits for Hydrogen Evolution Reactions
authors: Jerom Samraj Abraham and N. Rajasekaran
abstract: Co–Ni alloy with various compositions were fabricated through a one-step electrodeposition process and evaluated as electrocatalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). The electrocatalytic behavior of the deposited alloys were systematically investigated under both conventional electrocatalytic and magneto-electrocatalytic (0.3 T magnetic field strength) conditions. The Co–Ni alloy exhibited excellent HER activity, which was further enhanced upon the application of an external magnetic field.
